# plot_dgrid_as_volume { #mofography.visualize.plot_dgrid_as_volume }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Optional Plotly Volume view of a distance grid; mesh isosurfaces are the usual choice. Use `plot_surface_dgrid` instead.

```python
visualize.plot_dgrid_as_volume(
    dgrid,
    mat_atoms,
    original_shape=None,
    num_isosurfaces=5,
    cscale='viridis',
    opacity=0.1,
)
```

Visualise a distance grid (optionally padded in ‘wrap’ mode).



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

dgrid : np.ndarray
    3-D array holding the (possibly padded) distance grid.
mat_atoms : ASE Atoms object
    Provides the unit-cell vectors.
original_shape : tuple[int,int,int] or None
    Shape of the un-padded grid.  If None, the grid is assumed NOT padded.
num_isosurfaces : int
    How many iso-value surfaces to draw.
